note: Hand-written. Course display only, merged into vocab.json by scripts/build-greek-course.js. Keys are course word keys (vocab.json key); the data lemma stays on each entry for linking to orig/. displayLemma = the standard textbook dictionary form; courseGloss = a beginner's gloss where the lexicon gloss would mislead. All Greek NFC; the script checks every Greek word here against orig/nt.

ἔπω, ἐρῶ, εἶπον.displayNote: used as the aorist of λέγω, "I said"

εἶδον.displayNote: used as the aorist of ὁράω, "I saw"

οἶδα.displayNote: perfect in form, present in meaning

δέ.courseGloss: but, and (never first in its clause)

μέν.courseGloss: on the one hand (often left untranslated)

ἄν.courseGloss: particle of possibility: -ever, would (often left untranslated)
